/* PosRcvPayMomsMapper.getPosRcvPayMomsList */
SELECT tssps.STORE_CD , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(tssps.SALE_DATE, 'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS SALE_DATE , tssps.POS_NO , tssps.BILL_NO , tssps.SALE_YN , tssps.PAY_SEQ , CASE WHEN tssps.PAY_CD IN ('05','12') THEN '할인내역' ELSE '결제내역' END AS PAY_FG , tssps.PAY_CD , CASE WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='01' AND tsspc.CARD_NO IS NOT NULL THEN tsspc.CARD_NO WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='02' AND tsspca.CASH_BILL_CARD_NO IS NOT NULL THEN tsspca.CASH_BILL_CARD_NO WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='03' AND tsppc.PAYCO_BARCD_NO IS NOT NULL THEN tsppc.PAYCO_BARCD_NO WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='07' AND tsspmp.MPAY_BARCD_NO IS NOT NULL THEN tsspmp.MPAY_BARCD_NO WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='08' AND tsspmc.MCOUPN_BARCD_NO IS NOT NULL THEN tsspmc.MCOUPN_BARCD_NO ELSE '' END AS PAY_CD_NO , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE( CASE WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='01' AND tsspc.APPR_DT IS NOT NULL THEN tsspc.APPR_DT WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='02' AND tsspca.APPR_DT IS NOT NULL THEN tsspca.APPR_DT WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='03' AND tsppc.APPR_DT IS NOT NULL THEN tsppc.APPR_DT WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='07' AND tsspmp.APPR_DT IS NOT NULL THEN tsspmp.APPR_DT WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='08' AND tsspmc.APPR_DT IS NOT NULL THEN tsspmc.APPR_DT ELSE NULL END , 'yyyymmddhh24miss'), 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS APPR_DATE , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE( CASE WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='01' AND tsspc.APPR_DT IS NOT NULL THEN tsspc.APPR_DT WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='02' AND tsspca.APPR_DT IS NOT NULL THEN tsspca.APPR_DT WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='03' AND tsppc.APPR_DT IS NOT NULL THEN tsppc.APPR_DT WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='07' AND tsspmp.APPR_DT IS NOT NULL THEN tsspmp.APPR_DT WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='08' AND tsspmc.APPR_DT IS NOT NULL THEN tsspmc.APPR_DT ELSE NULL END , 'yyyymmddhh24miss'), 'hh24:mi:ss') AS APPR_TIME , CASE WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='01' AND tsspc.APPR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN tsspc.APPR_NO WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='02' AND tsspca.APPR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN tsspca.APPR_NO WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='03' AND tsppc.APPR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN tsppc.APPR_NO WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='07' AND tsspmp.APPR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN tsspmp.APPR_NO WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='08' AND tsspmc.APPR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN tsspmc.APPR_NO ELSE NULL END AS APPR_NO , CASE WHEN tssps.PAY_CD IN ('01','03','07','08') AND tssps.SALE_FG = '1' THEN '승인' WHEN tssps.PAY_CD IN ('01','03','07','08') AND tssps.SALE_FG = '-1' THEN '취소' WHEN tssps.PAY_CD = '02' AND tsspca.CASH_BILL_CARD_NO IS NOT NULL AND tssps.SALE_FG = '1' THEN '승인' WHEN tssps.PAY_CD = '02' AND tsspca.CASH_BILL_CARD_NO IS NOT NULL AND tssps.SALE_FG = '-1' THEN '취소' ELSE NULL END AS APPR_FG , CASE WHEN tssps.PAY_CD NOT IN ('05','12') THEN tssps.PAY_AMT ELSE 0 END AS TOT_SALE_AMT , CASE WHEN tssps.PAY_CD NOT IN ('05','12') THEN tssps.PAY_AMT ELSE 0 END AS REAL_SALE_AMT , CASE WHEN tssps.PAY_CD IN ('05','12') THEN tssps.PAY_AMT ELSE 0 END AS TOT_DC_AMT , CASE WHEN tssps.PAY_CD NOT IN ('05','12') THEN tssps.PAY_AMT - tssps.VAT_AMT ELSE 0 END AS GA_AMT , tssps.VAT_AMT , CASE WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='01' THEN tsspc.INST_CNT ELSE NULL END AS INST_CNT , CASE WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='01' THEN tsspc.ACQUIRE_CD ELSE NULL END AS ACQUIRE_CD , CASE WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='01' THEN tsspc.ACQUIRE_NM ELSE NULL END AS ACQUIRE_NM , CASE WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='01' THEN tsspc.ISSUE_CD ELSE NULL END AS ISSUE_CD , CASE WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='01' THEN tsspc.ISSUE_NM ELSE NULL END AS ISSUE_NM , CASE WHEN tssps.PAY_CD ='01' THEN (SELECT VAN_NM FROM TB_CM_VAN_CMPNY WHERE VAN_CD = tsspc.VAN_CD AND VAN_FG = '01') ELSE NULL END AS VAN_NM , CASE WHEN tssps.PAY_CD IN ('05','08','12') THEN tssps.PAY_AMT ELSE NULL END AS COUPON_AMT -- 원거래승인번호 , CASE WHEN tssps.PAY_CD = '01' AND tsspc.ORG_BILL_NO IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT APPR_NO FROM TB_SL_SALE_PAY_CARD WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = tsspc.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND STORE_CD = tsspc.STORE_CD AND SALE_DATE = SUBSTR(tsspc.ORG_BILL_NO,-14,8) AND POS_NO = SUBSTR(tsspc.ORG_BILL_NO,-6,2) AND BILL_NO = SUBSTR(tsspc.ORG_BILL_NO,-4)) WHEN tssps.PAY_CD = '02' AND tsspca.ORG_BILL_NO IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT APPR_NO FROM TB_SL_SALE_PAY_CASH WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = tsspca.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND STORE_CD = tsspca.STORE_CD AND SALE_DATE = SUBSTR(tsspca.ORG_BILL_NO,-14,8) AND POS_NO = SUBSTR(tsspca.ORG_BILL_NO,-6,2) AND BILL_NO = SUBSTR(tsspca.ORG_BILL_NO,-4) AND APPR_PROC_FG IN ('1','2','4')) WHEN tssps.PAY_CD = '03' AND tsppc.ORG_BILL_NO IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT APPR_NO FROM TB_SL_SALE_PAY_PAYCO WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = tsppc.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND STORE_CD = tsppc.STORE_CD AND SALE_DATE = SUBSTR(tsppc.ORG_BILL_NO,-14,8) AND POS_NO = SUBSTR(tsppc.ORG_BILL_NO,-6,2) AND BILL_NO = SUBSTR(tsppc.ORG_BILL_NO,-4)) WHEN tssps.PAY_CD = '07' AND tsspmp.ORG_BILL_NO IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT APPR_NO FROM TB_SL_SALE_PAY_MPAY WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = tsspmp.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND STORE_CD = tsspmp.STORE_CD AND SALE_DATE = SUBSTR(tsspmp.ORG_BILL_NO,-14,8) AND POS_NO = SUBSTR(tsspmp.ORG_BILL_NO,-6,2) AND BILL_NO = SUBSTR(tsspmp.ORG_BILL_NO,-4)) WHEN tssps.PAY_CD = '08' AND tsspmc.ORG_BILL_NO IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT APPR_NO FROM TB_SL_SALE_PAY_MCOUPN WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = tsspmc.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND STORE_CD = tsspmc.STORE_CD AND SALE_DATE = SUBSTR(tsspmc.ORG_BILL_NO,-14,8) AND POS_NO = SUBSTR(tsspmc.ORG_BILL_NO,-6,2) AND BILL_NO = SUBSTR(tsspmc.ORG_BILL_NO,-4)) ELSE NULL END AS ORG_APPR_NO -- 원거래승인일자 , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE( CASE WHEN tssps.PAY_CD = '01' AND tsspc.ORG_BILL_NO IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT APPR_DT FROM TB_SL_SALE_PAY_CARD WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = tsspc.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND STORE_CD = tsspc.STORE_CD AND SALE_DATE = SUBSTR(tsspc.ORG_BILL_NO,-14,8) AND POS_NO = SUBSTR(tsspc.ORG_BILL_NO,-6,2) AND BILL_NO = SUBSTR(tsspc.ORG_BILL_NO,-4)) WHEN tssps.PAY_CD = '02' AND tsspca.ORG_BILL_NO IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT APPR_DT FROM TB_SL_SALE_PAY_CASH WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = tsspca.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND STORE_CD = tsspca.STORE_CD AND SALE_DATE = SUBSTR(tsspca.ORG_BILL_NO,-14,8) AND POS_NO = SUBSTR(tsspca.ORG_BILL_NO,-6,2) AND BILL_NO = SUBSTR(tsspca.ORG_BILL_NO,-4) AND APPR_PROC_FG IN ('1','2','4')) WHEN tssps.PAY_CD = '03' AND tsppc.ORG_BILL_NO IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT APPR_DT FROM TB_SL_SALE_PAY_PAYCO WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = tsppc.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND STORE_CD = tsppc.STORE_CD AND SALE_DATE = SUBSTR(tsppc.ORG_BILL_NO,-14,8) AND POS_NO = SUBSTR(tsppc.ORG_BILL_NO,-6,2) AND BILL_NO = SUBSTR(tsppc.ORG_BILL_NO,-4)) WHEN tssps.PAY_CD = '07' AND tsspmp.ORG_BILL_NO IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT APPR_DT FROM TB_SL_SALE_PAY_MPAY WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = tsspmp.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND STORE_CD = tsspmp.STORE_CD AND SALE_DATE = SUBSTR(tsspmp.ORG_BILL_NO,-14,8) AND POS_NO = SUBSTR(tsspmp.ORG_BILL_NO,-6,2) AND BILL_NO = SUBSTR(tsspmp.ORG_BILL_NO,-4)) WHEN tssps.PAY_CD = '08' AND tsspmc.ORG_BILL_NO IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT APPR_DT FROM TB_SL_SALE_PAY_MCOUPN WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = tsspmc.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND STORE_CD = tsspmc.STORE_CD AND SALE_DATE = SUBSTR(tsspmc.ORG_BILL_NO,-14,8) AND POS_NO = SUBSTR(tsspmc.ORG_BILL_NO,-6,2) AND BILL_NO = SUBSTR(tsspmc.ORG_BILL_NO,-4)) ELSE NULL END , 'yyyymmddhh24miss'), 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS ORG_APPR_DATE FROM TB_SL_SALE_PAY_SEQ tssps , TB_SL_SALE_HDR tssh , TB_SL_SALE_PAY_CARD tsspc , TB_SL_SALE_PAY_CASH tsspca , TB_SL_SALE_PAY_PAYCO tsppc , TB_SL_SALE_PAY_MPAY tsspmp , TB_SL_SALE_PAY_MCOUPN tsspmc WHERE tssps.HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND tssps.STORE_CD = #{storeCd} AND tssps.SALE_DATE = #{saleDate} AND tssh.HQ_OFFICE_CD = tssps.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND tssh.STORE_CD = tssps.STORE_CD AND tssh.SALE_DATE = tssps.SALE_DATE AND tssh.POS_NO = tssps.POS_NO AND tssh.BILL_NO = tssps.BILL_NO AND tsspc.HQ_OFFICE_CD (+) = tssps.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND tsspc.STORE_CD (+) = tssps.STORE_CD AND tsspc.SALE_DATE (+) = tssps.SALE_DATE AND tsspc.POS_NO (+) = tssps.POS_NO AND tsspc.BILL_NO (+) = tssps.BILL_NO AND tsspc.LINE_NO (+) = tssps.LINE_NO AND tsspca.HQ_OFFICE_CD (+) = tssps.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND tsspca.STORE_CD (+) = tssps.STORE_CD AND tsspca.SALE_DATE (+) = tssps.SALE_DATE AND tsspca.POS_NO (+) = tssps.POS_NO AND tsspca.BILL_NO (+) = tssps.BILL_NO AND tsspca.LINE_NO (+) = tssps.LINE_NO AND tsspca.APPR_PROC_FG (+) IN ('1','2','4') AND tsppc.HQ_OFFICE_CD (+) = tssps.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND tsppc.STORE_CD (+) = tssps.STORE_CD AND tsppc.SALE_DATE (+) = tssps.SALE_DATE AND tsppc.POS_NO (+) = tssps.POS_NO AND tsppc.BILL_NO (+) = tssps.BILL_NO AND tsppc.LINE_NO (+) = tssps.LINE_NO AND tsspmp.HQ_OFFICE_CD (+) = tssps.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND tsspmp.STORE_CD (+) = tssps.STORE_CD AND tsspmp.SALE_DATE (+) = tssps.SALE_DATE AND tsspmp.POS_NO (+) = tssps.POS_NO AND tsspmp.BILL_NO (+) = tssps.BILL_NO AND tsspmp.LINE_NO (+) = tssps.LINE_NO AND tsspmc.HQ_OFFICE_CD (+) = tssps.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND tsspmc.STORE_CD (+) = tssps.STORE_CD AND tsspmc.SALE_DATE (+) = tssps.SALE_DATE AND tsspmc.POS_NO (+) = tssps.POS_NO AND tsspmc.BILL_NO (+) = tssps.BILL_NO AND tsspmc.LINE_NO (+) = tssps.LINE_NO ORDER BY tssps.POS_NO, tssps.BILL_NO, tssps.PAY_SEQ
